First, convert 24 weeks and 5 days to days:  
24 weeks × 7 days/week = 168 days, plus 5 days = 173 days.  

Subtract 173 days from 1897-09-22:  
September has 30 days, so going back:  
1897-09-22 minus 22 days → 1897-08-31.  
Remaining days: 173 − 22 = 151 days.  

August 31 back 31 days → 1897-07-31. Remaining: 151 − 31 = 120 days.  
July has 31 days, so July 31 back 31 days → 1897-06-30. Remaining: 120 − 31 = 89 days.  
June has 30 days, so June 30 back 30 days → 1897-05-31. Remaining: 89 − 30 = 59 days.  
May has 31 days, so May 31 back 31 days → 1897-04-30. Remaining: 59 − 31 = 28 days.  
April 30 back 28 days → 1897-04-02.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1897-04-02
